results.title: A token past its validity
results.evidence: a token whose validity ended nine years ago was stored and is counted in coverage: 1 of 1 anchored head(s) 'carry a token'. Nothing in `stamp` looks at the token at all — not `genTime`, not `notAfter` — because verification is delegated to a verifier that is not wired, and coverage counts `state != absent`.
